petition_no: 324/MP/2025 and 279/MP/2025 along with IA No. 75/2025 and IA No. 256/2025
summary: [¶] Petition under Section 79 (1)(c) and 79(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Clause 5(xiii) of Detailed Procedure issued under Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access) Regulations, 2022 seeking direction to CTUIL/Respondent to approve AEPL’s request for renewable energy source change with respect to Connectivity dated 01.02.2024. [¶] **6.** Petitioner No. 1, AEPL, under Petition 279/MP/2025, is the same as Petitioner under Petition 324/MP/2025. The generation project of 50 MW covered under both Petitions is the same, and accordingly, similar submissions under both Petitions are not repeated separately under each Petition. Petitioners vide IA No. 256/2025 in Petition No 279/MP/2025 prayed to allow deletion of AGPL as Petitioner No. 2 and allow addition of AGPL as Proforma Respondent No. [para 2] 2. The said prayer to consider AGPL as Proforma Respondent No.2 in place of Petitioner No. 2 is accepted. The pleadings for the Order have accordingly been considered. [¶] raised in the present Petition has been substantially resolved by the Commission’s Record of the Proceedings (‘RoP’) for the hearing dated 13.5.2025 issued in Petition No. 453/MP/2025 & Ors. (i.e, Oyster Renewable Energy Private Limited vs CTUIL & Ors). However, the Petitioners may be permitted to approach the Commission in the event that any grievance remains unresolved. The Respondent, CTUIL, submitted that in the present case as well, CTUIL will comply with the directions issued by the Commission in the aforementioned Record of Proceedings, and the matter may, accordingly, be reserved for the order. [¶] **17.** Petitioners under Petition No. 279/MP/2025 vide IA 256/2025 have prayed to modify Petitioner No. 2 as Proforma Respondent in place of co-Petitioner. The Commission allowed the said prayer of Petitioners under Petition No. 279/MP/2025. Accordingly, Petitioner under both Petitions 324/MP/2025 and 279/MP/2025 shall be AEPL only. [¶] CTUIL. Accordingly, the Commission directs Respondent, CTUIL, to process the application of Petitioner within 30 days of issuance of this Order, as per the relevant provisions of GNA Regulation,2022, in case not processed already. [¶] **24.** Considering the above, we observe that the prayers under the instant Petitions are addressed, and accordingly, Petition No. 324/MP/2025 and Petition No. 279/MP/2025, along with IA No. 75/2025 and 256/2025, are disposed of in terms of the above **.** [¶] **Order in Petition Number 324/MP/2025 and 279/MP/2025 along with IAs75/2025 and IA No. 256/2025**
